primary_route: Isotope tracing, step blockade/restoration and proposed biochemical reconstitution.

checks.reason: Historical identity lookup is not a plan to consult detailed prior Methods/protocols, select conditions and verify transfer before execution.
No sham wash or inactive/matched-protein enzyme add-back control for the decisive restoration.
Heat inactivation can destroy contaminating enzymes too; a negative killed preparation cannot exclude enzymatic contamination in the live preparation.
Generic tissue preparation with no identifiable tissue/system selection or concrete prerequisite resolution; batch numbering does not specify the preparation.
No quantitative preparation/buffer/cofactor recipe or concrete calibration procedure to choose these conditions and sampling times.
Correct independence but a fixed minimum of three has no precision, effect-size or pilot-variance justification.
A positive no-added-substrate result can be genuine endogenous metabolism. Automatically invalidating such a run selects against a biological alternative rather than diagnosing measurement failure.
Repeatedly stopping when an ordinary CI excludes a threshold or includes zero lacks a sequential-error/coverage rule; preregistration alone does not repair repeated peeking.

A killed preparation cannot establish the maximum carbon obtainable by one-pass carrier oxidation; inhibition can also truncate that maximum. This yields a nonconservative ceiling, distinct from the separate label-replacement inference.
No bounded carrier/substrate dose exploration with an objective selection criterion and confirmatory lock.
No refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after changing labels, pool depletion or inhibitor conditions.

Carrier label loss with mass replacement and single-step dependence can also occur through parallel degradation/anaplerosis or partial routes. No operational atom-return or identifiable competing-flux test supports forced unique cycle assignment; zero added-carrier effect also need not mean no cycling.
Partially purified or one-enzyme-depleted tissue does not define the full enzyme inventory; the proposed independent confirmation leaves contaminating activities unresolved.
No sample/raw-file/code/model/version/settings linkage sufficient to reproduce all contrasts.

Independent units are recognized, but replication justification, valid carbon ceiling, uniquely identifying return logic and fully defined confirmation are incomplete. Overclaim consequences are charged under P13 only.
